definitions.explanation: Making significant changes or improvements; introducing new ideas or methods.

examples.japanese: ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧{革新|かくしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
⟦{革新的|かくしんてき}→革新的：05662_kakushinteki⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦アイデア→アイデア：10161_aidea⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|う}み{出|だ}す→生み出す：10423_umidasu⟧。
examples.english: To come up with innovative ideas.

examples.japanese: ⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{革新|かくしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Reform of the system is necessary.

notes:
{革新|かくしん} means innovation or reform - significant change bringing improvement or modernization.

ETYMOLOGY:
{革|かく} (reform, change) + {新|しん} (new) = innovation

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧{革新|かくしん}: technological innovation
- ⟦{革新的|かくしんてき}→革新的：05662_kakushinteki⟧(な): innovative
- {革新|かくしん}⟦{政党|せいとう}→政党：04338_seitou⟧: progressive/reform party

COMMON PATTERNS:
Can function as ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb: {革新|かくしん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to innovate, to reform)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦イノベーション→イノベーション：06407_inobeeshon⟧: innovation (loanword)
- ⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧: reform (often political/institutional)
- ⟦{刷新|さっしん}→刷新：07520_sasshin⟧: renovation, complete renewal

POLITICAL USAGE:
{革新|かくしん} often refers to progressive/left-leaning politics, contrasted with ⟦{保守|ほしゅ}→保守：19090_hoshu⟧ (conservative).
